title: Sunday · the Fourth, 2006
logline: White fireworks. The dock. Maria in the crowd for the first time, next to Gully at the machine. The chair empty.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the dock, night, crowded, white fireworks on Prussian blue. GULLY pouring; MARIA beside him handing out cups — the first Fourth with her. WOOD on the steps with BARNABY.

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks on a deep blue watercolor sky, a man in an apron pouring coffee with a practical woman beside him handing out cups, a thin man on shack steps with an old dog

panels.name: Two at the machine

panels.composition: Tier 2: the lawn chair under the eave. Empty. Maria glancing at it. Gully shaking his head, small: not yet.

image.prompt: a practical woman glancing at an empty green-webbed lawn chair under a shack's eave, a man beside her giving a tiny head-shake, watercolor

panels.name: Not yet

panels.composition: Tier 3: the finale. White on blue. Two at the machine. One on the steps with a dog. One chair.

image.prompt: a fireworks finale in white over a blue night bay above a crowded dock, a couple at a shack door, a man and a dog on the steps, an empty lawn chair under the eave, watercolor, no words

panels.name: One chair

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: Maria's first Fourth. The chair: not yet.
